notes: Summary: LexArchive builds an enterprise RAG product for mid-size law firms and corporate compliance teams. Heavy e-discovery workloads, PII/PHI in docs, must stay inside customer VPC or on-prem. Interested in Redwood private + Optimize to tune embeddings/reranking.

Initial technical targets: index up to 50M doc objects (expected 4-8TB vector store), peak query throughput 200 qps, p95 latency target <= 300ms for retrieval-only, p95 end-to-end (retrieve + rerank) target <= 700ms, cost target <$0.02/query but CFO pushing for <$0.01 at scale.

Retrieval strategy: two-stage pipeline. ANN (HNSW) for initial candidate fetch (~50-150 vectors), then cross-encoder reranker (BERT-like) for top-10 reorder. Want Redwood to support efficient reranking on private infra and provide kernel/quantization guidance.

Embedding requirements: prefer open-source embeddings (1280-1536 dim) to avoid vendor lock; vector refresh cadence nightly + delta updates during litigation events. Must support embedding provenance and immutable mapping to original doc id.

Security & compliance: SSO/SAML for app access, customer-managed KMS, strict audit logging capturing prompt+response, token-level metadata, exportable immutable logs for e-discovery requests. Retention policy: preserve logs and indexes for 7 years; legal may request longer retention on a case basis.

POC scope agreed 2026-03: ingest representative 2.5M doc corpus (contracts + emails), run baseline recall/precision + rerank effectiveness, benchmark latency and cost per query using Redwood Dedicated vs Private. POC duration 3 weeks + 1 week analysis.
